span.p:
Verified defect: cancel/ and food_already/
save the new status, then construct
OrderCancel(oid=) which raises
ValueError - Order instance required.
Status persists, response is 500,
no order_ordercancel row is written.
order/views.py:91 and :111

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
order_order.complete_time is never
written by any action - it stays NULL
for the whole lifecycle.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No guards anywhere: every action does a
bare Order.objects.get(oid=...) and
overwrites status. Any state reaches any
state, and only /order/delete/ filters on
the caller's uid (views.py:164), so any
authenticated user can drive another
member's order. Arrows above are the
INTENDED path, not an enforced one.
